Turn every image into one luminance channel.

Each pixel becomes 0.2989 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B (torchvision Grayscale), in training, validation and test. The model's input shape becomes [H, W, 1].

| | |
| --- | --- |

## Settings

The node has no settings.

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Grayscale is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Grayscale -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Runs in training, validation and test. The model's input becomes [H, W, 1].
```

## Tips

- A third of the input size when colour does not matter.
